fields.description: Registry this image is pulled from; supplies the host prefix and the pull credentials.
fields.label: Image Provider

fields.description: Repository path and tag within the registry, e.g. 'vllm/vllm-openai:v0.11.0'. The registry host is prefixed automatically.
fields.label: Image Path

fields.description: What is inside the image. 'vllm' — the entrypoint takes `vllm serve` arguments, so a placement derives them from the Model. 'custom' — the image serves on its own (an ASR container, say); no serve arguments are derived and the placement runs the image's own entrypoint plus whatever Startup Command is set.
fields.label: Engine Kind

fields.description: Path POSTed once after the health gate to prove the engine runs a forward pass, e.g. '/v1/audio/transcriptions'. Only this image knows the surface it serves, so it is named here rather than per placement. Blank skips the step — the health gate is then the whole proof. Set the placement's Health Path alongside it: with no gate the warmup fires the moment the container starts, before anything is listening. A vllm image derives its own and ignores this.
fields.label: Warmup Path

fields.description: JSON object sent as that request's body — the smallest input the image accepts. Blank posts {}. Must parse to an object: a failure here fails the deploy, so keep it to something the image answers 200 to in a second or two.
fields.label: Warmup Body

fields.description: Architecture this image is built for. Matched against the box's at deployment, and used to pick the right entry out of a multi-arch tag when reading the size.
fields.label: CPU Architecture

fields.description: Derived '/' — the ref passed to the provider.
fields.label: Full Image

fields.description: Compressed size of this image's layers, summed off the registry's own manifest — what a first pull downloads. Docker writes it out larger than this: the layers are unpacked onto the box's disk. Press Fetch Size to read it.
fields.label: Size (GB)
